1. YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE

All entries are encrypted and stored only on this device. Nothing is sent to any server, cloud, or third party. Cryptex has zero access to your data.

2. YOUR PIN IS YOUR KEY

Your 4-digit PIN protects everything. Cryptex does not store or know your PIN — there is no "forgot PIN" via email or phone number.

3. RECOVERY OPTIONS

✅ Forgot PIN?
Answer your security question (set in the next step) to reset your PIN.

✅ Have a backup (.cxb file)?
Uninstall and reinstall the app, then import your backup using your backup password to restore all your data.

❌ Forgot PIN + forgot security answer + no backup?
Data cannot be recovered. There is no override or reset.

❌ Have a backup but forgot the backup password?
The backup cannot be decrypted. The password is never stored anywhere — not even by Cryptex.

4. DATA SECURITY

Your data is encrypted with AES-256-GCM. It cannot be read without your password.

⚠️ Your data can only be accessed by someone who knows your PIN or backup password. Keep them private. If someone gains physical access to your device AND knows your PIN, they can access your data.

5. NO WARRANTY / LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

Cryptex and its developer provide this app "as is" with no warranty. The developer is NOT responsible for:
• Loss of data due to forgotten PIN, lost backup, or device failure
• Unauthorised access if your PIN or password is disclosed
• Any damage arising from use or inability to use this app

You use Cryptex entirely at your own risk. You are solely responsible for keeping your credentials safe.

6. YOUR RESPONSIBILITY

• Remember or safely store your PIN
• Set a strong backup password
• Export backups regularly
• Keep your backup file safe
• Never share your PIN or password

By tapping "I Agree", you confirm you have read, understood, and accepted all of the above.

resources.string: 💡 Protect Your Data — Set Up Backup

Your data is encrypted on this device only. If you lose your phone, you lose your data — unless you have a backup.

Here's how to stay safe:

1️⃣ Settings → Export Backup
Save your backup (.cxb) to Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, or any cloud storage you use.

2️⃣ Turn on Auto-Backup
Your backup updates automatically every time you make a change.

Export once. Auto-Backup does the rest.
